reason: A DSH web plugin that aggregates token usage and presents provider balances and subscription quotas in a dashboard with charts and read-only API endpoints.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中汇总 Token 用量，并展示供应商余额、订阅配额和趋势图表。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that summarizes token usage and displays provider balances, subscription quotas, and usage trends.

capabilities: Aggregates token usage from session event logs
Displays provider balances and subscription quotas
Reads provider account data through configured credentials
Renders a web dashboard with charts and summaries
